view_service_record.title: Serviciu de vizualizare UAT II (raion, municipiu, UTA)
view_service_record.description: named polygon boundaries for districts, Chișinău, Bălți and Găgăuzia
view_service_record.service_conditions: Service metadata does not specify a fee or access constraint; this does not resolve underlying dataset reuse rights, which remain marked unknown.
view_service_record.capabilities_observation: Returned HTTP 200, WMS 1.3.0; layer is queryable and server advertises GetMap and GetFeatureInfo. Three GetFeatureInfo requests were later made in text/plain format for representative existing cell centers; no GetMap or bulk request was made.

bounded_current_service_identify.request: WMS 1.3.0 GetFeatureInfo; layer and query_layers w_rsuat:mv_uat1; CRS:84; 3x3 pixel request centered at I=1,J=1; bbox +/-0.0002 degrees around each existing source-cell center; INFO_FORMAT=text/plain; FEATURE_COUNT=5.

observations.residual_stratum: MDA archived-source match plus UKR contact
observations.result: One current UAT II feature identified. This is a current-service label/identity observation, not evidence for the consumed 2020 feature's source vintage or geometry.
One current UAT II feature identified. A current label match does not establish whether this residual center belongs to the historical source feature or why the retained archive differs.

observations.residual_stratum: UKR contact outside archived MDA source
observations.result: No current service feature was returned for this point. This does not distinguish omission, service coverage, or a historical source exclusion and cannot disposition the wider Transnistria group.

bounded_current_service_identify.response_handling: Python's TLS validation failed locally before reaching the service. System curl with normal certificate verification succeeded. An initial application/json GetFeatureInfo response included full feature geometry; it was not saved or redistributed. Subsequent bounded requests used text/plain, which returned selected attributes and a geometry summary only; no coordinate arrays were retained.
bounded_current_service_identify.scope_limit: Three representative samples only. No bulk extraction, GetMap, WFS, downloaded dataset, or full 133-cell query.

additional_limit: The 2025 INDS monitoring table lists view service availability for administrative unit levels I/II but no WFS or file-based download. The ordinary cadastral viewer URL returned a region/country-unavailable response; no alternate route was used.
disposition: Current-service identify results give limited corroboration for the Taraclia and Ștefan Vodă labels and no feature at one Transnistria sample point. They do not establish the 2020 snapshot, source-feature identity, current-to-2020 geometry equivalence, or per-cell applicability. The three heterogeneous samples cannot classify the 133 residuals. No MDA cell, owner, hold, qualification, repair, or credit changed.
privacy: Raw metadata responses are not copied here because they include named contact details. Raw WMS feature geometry was not retained or published; only three bounded current-layer attributes and the no-feature response are recorded.
